body: **Verification:** Retested on Staging after the fix. Prospect is Unsubscribed in Saleshandy trigger, Create a Lead in Pipedrive activity: when the prospect is not in Pipedrive, the person is created with one lead titled with the prospect's email. When the person exists, a new lead is added to that person. Together with Create a Deal and Create a Person, the result is 1 person, 1 lead, 1 deal and 1 activity.
waitingFor: QA to send from npm run jira. Source: Pipedrive Prospect Unsubscribed reruns on 2026-10-29.
